The first zip archive was created successfully and its source directory was deleted, so I can now apply the same verified operation to the remaining four vacation spots.

```python
for vacation_directory in vacation_spot_directories[1:]:
    vacation_spot = vacation_directory.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1]
    compression_results[vacation_spot] = apis.file_system.compress_directory(
        access_token=file_system_access_token,
        directory_path=vacation_directory,
        compressed_file_path=f'{vacation_root}{vacation_spot}.zip',
        delete_directory=True,
        overwrite=False
    )
print(compression_results)
```
